description.en: A recipe for strudel dough that requires overnight freezing before being rolled out, filled, and baked.
description.he: מתכון לבצק שטרודל הדורש הקפאה למשך לילה לפני רידוד, מילוי ואפייה.

en: Combine all ingredients to form a dough.
he: לערבב את כל המרכיבים ליצירת בצק.
לאפות ב-375 מעלות פרנהייט למשך שעה וחצי.

ocrRawText:
Ernst & Young
FOR 125 YEARS, CLARKSON GORDON IN CANADA
Mams Strudel Dough

1/2 lb crisco (1 cup)
1/2 pt sour cream
pinch salt
3 cups flour
freeze over night divide dough
roll out and fill
375° - 1 1/2 hrs.
rankingReason: Result A is more accurate to the source. The original handwritten text clearly says 'Mams' (not 'Mama's'), and 'crisco' is the correct ingredient, not 'butter'. Result B's OCR contains significant errors: it misreads 'crisco' as 'butter', invents 'Miracle Whip' as an ingredient, reduces flour from 3 cups to 2 cups, and changes sour cream from 1/2 pt to 1/4 pt. Result B's description also incorrectly notes the handwriting is 'upside-down' when the OCR raw text is perfectly legible. While Result B has slightly better formatting and more tags, these don't outweigh its fundamental OCR inaccuracies that would result in a failed recipe if someone followed it.
